note: Leaves the shelter through the open north window, which is slow to cross, into the field.

statement: A house stands in the field a short walk from the shelter; its windows are locked, with a bedroom, bathroom with bathtub, kitchen and a gray basement-like room inside

note: Scouts the nearby house and fills a kettle with water, advancing the find-water-and-vessel plan.

statement: The house bathroom held medical supplies (ibuprofen, alcohol wipes, antiseptic, vitamin C, gummy vitamin, soap bars, cotton balls, adhesive bandages), which the survivor took

note: Drops one ration box on the floor to cut weight; the survivor now carries 2 ration boxes.

statement: The house kitchen cupboard held a hammer, pliers, screwdriver, lighter (14/100 butane), flashlight and batteries, which the survivor took, and a kettle is in the kitchen
The house kitchen refrigerator held pineapple juice bottles, tofu and other food; the survivor took 4 portions of pineapple juice
The house bathtub holds about 6 L of dirty water that can be poured into a kettle
Dirty water becomes clean water by crafting (boiling), which needs a nearby fire or a cooker or other tool with a boiling quality

note: Boiling water needs a fire or heat source; the survivor has the matchbook and (from the house) a lighter.
Hot clean water from boiling is poured into the kettle.

statement: The survivor can craft a large wooden bowl from memory
Zombies, including a zombie runner, roam 33 to 56 tiles to the south and southeast of the shelter area, spotted from the field

note: Returns to the evac shelter A-23 to craft the bowl and boil water.
The shelter floor still holds 19 small cardboard boxes of protein ration, consistent with the handoff count.
Rewields the wooden club after crafting before heading out.

statement: The survivor's save is in the world named Cedar Butte (load menu shows Morgan Vale there), not Baytown
At the end the survivor carries 2 protein ration boxes, 4 clean water portions, 4 pineapple juice portions and the medical supplies; 19 ration boxes remain at the shelter
